build_fc_layers: build fully connected layers with batch normalization and ReLU from a config list
assign_stack_targets: assign classification and box labels to 3D points using ground truth bounding boxes
get_cls_layer_loss: compute the classification loss for point predictions using sigmoid focal loss
get_box_layer_loss: compute the regression loss for point box predictions using smooth L1 loss
generate_predicted_boxes: decode predicted point box encodings into final 3D bounding box predictions
